sn35.245:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn35.245:1.2: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti ||
sn35.245:1.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || || 3
sn35.245:2.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn35.245:2.2: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:2.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcannam upādānakkhandhānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || || 4
sn35.245:3.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn35.245:3.2: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:3.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu catunnam mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || la || || 5
sn35.245:4.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || || 6
sn35.245:5.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Idhāham bhante yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avocaṃ ||
sn35.245:5.2: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:5.3: Evaṃ vutte bhante so bhikkhu mam etad avoca || ||
sn35.245:5.4: Yato kho āvuso channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:5.5: Atha khvāham bhante asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhum etad avocaṃ ||
sn35.245:5.6: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:5.7: Evaṃ vutte bhante so bhikkhu mam etad avoca || ||
sn35.245:5.8: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu pañcannam upādānakkhandhānaṃ || pe ||
sn35.245:5.9: catunnam mahābhūtānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || pe ||
sn35.245:5.10: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || ||
sn35.245:5.11: Atha khvāham bhante asantuṭṭho tassa bhikkhussa pañhavyākaraṇena yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ ||
sn35.245:5.12: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhuno suvisuddhaṃ hotīti || || 7
sn35.245:6.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhu purisassa kiṃsuko adiṭṭhapubbo assa ||
sn35.245:6.2: so yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya || upasaṅkamitvā tam purisam evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:6.5: Kālako kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko seyyathāpi jhāmakhāṇūti ||
sn35.245:6.6: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:7.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya || upasaṅkamitvā tam purisam evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.4: Lohitako kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko seyyathāpi maṃsapesīti ||
sn35.245:7.5: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:7.6: Atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya || upasaṅkamitvā tam purisam evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.9: Odīrakajāto kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko ādiṇṇasipātiko seyyathāpi sirīso ti ||
sn35.245:7.10: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:7.11: Atha kho so bhikkhu puriso asantuṭṭho tassa purisassa pañhavyākaraṇena yenaññataro puriso kiṃsukassa dassāvī tenupasaṅkameyya || upasaṅkamitvā tam purisam evaṃ vadeyya
sn35.245:7.14: Bahalapattapalāso kho ambho purisa kiṃsuko sandacchāyo seyyathāpi nigrodho ti ||
sn35.245:7.15: tena kho pana bhikkhu samayena tādiso vassa kiṃsuko yathāpi tassa purisassa dassanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:7.16: Evam eva kho bhikkhu yathā yathā adhimuttānaṃ tesaṃ sappurisānaṃ dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ tathā tathā kho tehi sappurisehi vyākataṃ || || 8
sn35.245:8.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhu rañño paccantimaṃ nagaram daḷhuddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇam chadvāraṃ ||
sn35.245:8.2: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito vyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivaretā ñātānam pavesetā || ||
sn35.245:8.3: Puratthimāya disāya āgantvā sīgham dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikam evaṃ vadeyya ||
sn35.245:8.4: Kaham bho purisa imassa nagarassa nagarasāmīti ||
sn35.245:8.6: Eso bhante majjhe siṅghāṭake nisinno ti || ||
sn35.245:8.7: Atha kho taṃ sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ niyyādetvā yathāgatamaggam paṭipajjeyya ||
sn35.245:8.8: pacchimāya disāya āgantvā sīgham dūtayugaṃ || pe ||
sn35.245:8.10: āgantvā sīghaṃ dūtayugaṃ taṃ dovārikam evam vadeyya ||
sn35.245:8.11: Kaham bho purisa imassa nagarassa nagarasāmīti ||
sn35.245:8.13: Eso bhante majjhe siṅghātake nisinno ti ||
sn35.245:8.14: atha kho taṃ siṅghaṃ dūtayugaṃ nagarasāmissa yathābhūtaṃ vacanaṃ niyyādetvā yathāgatamaggam paṭipajjeyya || 9
sn35.245:9.1: Upamā kho myāyam bhikkhu katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn35.245:9.3: Nagaran ti kho bhikkhu imassetaṃ catumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ || mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsupacayassa aniccucchādana-parimaddana-
sn35.245:9.4: bhedana-viddhaṃsanadhammassa || || Chadvārā ti kho bhikkhu channetam ajjhattikānam āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:9.5: Dovāriko ti kho bhikkhu satiyā etam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:9.6: Sīghaṃ dūtayugan ti kho bhikkhu samathavipassanānetam adhivacanam || ||
sn35.245:9.8: Majjhe siṅghātako ti kho bhikkhu catunnetam mahābhūtānam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn35.245:9.10: Yathābhūtam vacanan ti kho bhikkhu nibbānassetam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn35.245:9.11: Yathāgatamaggo ti kho bhikkhu ariyassetam aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ || Seyyathīdaṃ
